description: This file defines a JavaScript module that provides a function to fetch session duration histogram data from a backend API. It includes a helper function for building query strings and exports an asynchronous function 'getDurationHistogram' that constructs API requests with various parameters, handles responses, and manages errors.

methods.name: buildQueryString
methods.description: Helper function to build URL query strings from parameters object, encoding arrays and objects appropriately.

methods.name: getDurationHistogram
methods.description: Asynchronous function that constructs and sends a GET request to fetch session duration histogram data, with support for default date ranges, parameter normalization, and error handling.
